name: Gravity-Compensating Hydraulic Damper

comparison_to_strongest_alternative.damper_advantage: Proportional damping (smooth response) vs binary threshold (ASD). Damper maintains closer to target flow across posture range.
comparison_to_strongest_alternative.asd_advantage: Simpler design, established clinical track record
comparison_to_strongest_alternative.verdict: DAMPER SURVIVES — provides proportional overdrainage prevention. Upright flow within 2x of target. ASD also prevents but with binary behavior.

dynamic_response.note: Damper is FASTER than ASD (passive hydraulic vs mechanical threshold). Both are passive (no electronics).

failure_modes: Damper element fatigue (elastomer compression set over years)
Gas diffusion through membrane (if gas spring)
evidence_label: MODELLED — analytical Poiseuille + compressible element model. Needs bench validation.
